description: Highest density residential district in NYC. Quality Housing mandatory for contextual R10A and R10X. Allows very tall towers (15+ stories). Maximum FAR in the city.

bulk.far_note: UAP standard. Highest residential FAR in NYC. Community facility FAR per ZR §24-11. Note: in Manhattan CD7, R10 (no suffix) limited to 10.0 FAR per ZR §23-733.
bulk.quality_housing_mandatory: true for R10A and R10X; optional for R10 without suffix

height_setback.regulation_type: Quality Housing (mandatory for R10A/R10X; optional for R10)
height_setback.notes: Per ZR §23-432 table (R10X1, R10X2, R10-1, R10-2, R10A1, R10A2 rows). R10A2 / R10X2 / R10-2: min base 60, max base 125, max height 185 ft standard. R10A1 / R10X1 / R10-1: max base 155, max height 215 ft standard. All: qualifying extends max height to 235 ft. Tower regulations (§23-435) permit tower penetrations in non-contextual R10.

side.requirement: Per §23-335: none required for Quality Housing contextual

rear.through_lot_alternative: Rear yard equivalent per §23-343 on through lots ≥180 ft

permitted_uses.parking: Parking not permitted in front yard
